Amal's own lines are garbled by the engine in places (08:57/08:59 'سعود' for صوّروا, 10:14 'وحم', 43:07/43:29 'سيفاء' for عاصفة, 36:44 'زد أن دنع'). Left out as S4 pronunciation: 'ams' for حمّس (10:17), 'bansabit' for بنبسط (11:16, 54:52), 'joan' for جوعان (53:24), 'iħna biniz'aj' -> her 'ej sound' remark (33:44-33:54), 'Azajit' for أزعجت (51:40), 'إيه' for هي (57:49, 59:13), the 'Full، مش hot' remark on شبعان (55:23), and the ع-stress remarks at 50:50-51:28.
